text:
1. Update vouchers for the selected company and period.
2. Review payables and receivables grids.
3. Generate the aging report for auditors or management.

- Aging vouchers imported for the financial year
- Company, FY, and period set in the company bar

1. Go to **Aging → Trade Payables**.
2. Review ledger-wise outstanding and duration buckets.
[Image: Trade payables grid with aging buckets and Calculate action]
1. Click **Calculate** to refresh payables from voucher data.
2. Export combined aging via Aging report after receivables and payables are both calculated.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Empty grid | Missing vouchers | Import voucher data first |
| Report missing payables sheet | No payables rows for period | Verify supplier vouchers exist for FY/period |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Aging vouchers imported for the financial year
- Company, FY, and period set in the company bar

1. Go to **Aging → Trade Receivables**.
2. Review ledger-wise outstanding and day buckets (0–30, 31–60, etc.).
1. Click **Calculate** to refresh receivables from voucher data for the current period.
2. Confirm rows appear before generating the Aging report.
[Image: Trade receivables grid with aging buckets and Calculate action]

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Empty grid after Calculate | No voucher data | Import vouchers or enable Tally aging import |
| Totals mismatch Tally | Period mismatch | Align period in company bar with Tally period |
| Stale balances | Calculate not run | Run **Calculate** after new imports |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Voucher data imported (Aging vouchers or Tally import with **Import Data for Aging** enabled)
- **Calculate** run on Trade receivables and Trade payables for the current period
- Company, FY, and period set in the company bar

1. Go to **Aging → Aging Report**.
2. Confirm **Company**, **Financial year**, **Period**, and **Entity type** on the left card match your intent.
1. Open **Trade Receivables**, **Trade Payables**, or **Aging Vouchers** from the quick links if balances are stale.
2. Run **Calculate** on receivables and payables grids before generating.
1. Click **Generate Aging Report** on the right card.
2. Stay on the page until the download starts (generation may take up to a minute while balance sheet data is prepared).
3. Open the workbook: **Summary** sheet plus **Trade Receivables** and **Trade Payables** detail sheets when data exists.
"Template format"
The Excel template depends on entity type (company vs other). The summary sheet lists company name, status, period, and FY end date.
[Image: Aging Report page with report scope card and Generate Aging Report button]

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Error on generate | Balance sheet prep failed | Check service connection; retry after Calculate on aging grids |
| Empty detail sheets | No rows for period | Import vouchers; verify FY and period in company bar |
| Download stalls | Large dataset | Wait up to 2 minutes; do not navigate away during generation |
| Prior-year balances wrong | Missing prior FY vouchers | Import previous year data for multi-year outstanding items |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company and financial year selected
- For Tally users: Import from Tally with **Import Data for Aging** checked
- For non-Tally users: Excel template from this screen

1. Go to **Aging → Vouchers**.
2. Review existing voucher rows for the selected company and FY.
[Image: Aging Vouchers grid with company bar and voucher import options]
**Tally users:** Vouchers import automatically with Tally data when aging import is enabled.
**Excel users:**
1. Scroll to the template section at the bottom of the page.
2. Download the voucher Excel template.
3. Fill required voucher details (ledger, amounts, dates).
4. Upload via **Import from Excel** and follow on-screen validation.
1. Open Trade receivables and Trade payables.
2. Click **Calculate** for the current period.
3. Generate the Aging report.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| No vouchers after Tally import | Aging option not ticked | Re-import with **Import Data for Aging** enabled |
| Excel import rejected | Template version mismatch | Re-download template from this page |
| Aging buckets wrong | Prior FY outstanding | Import prior-year vouchers |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Headquarters company created on Manage company with **location type** set to headquarters
- Branch companies share the same **income tax number (PAN)** as the headquarters
- Branch records exist as separate companies in the grid

1. Go to **Company → Manage Companies**.
2. On the headquarters row, click the **Manage Branches** icon ().
3. Confirm the page header shows **Branches** for the selected headquarters.
[Image: Manage Company grid with Manage Branches action on headquarters row]
1. Click **Add** in the branches grid.
2. Select a branch company from the autocomplete list (only companies with matching PAN and non-headquarters location type appear).
3. Save the link.
1. Use **Export** on the company grid when you need a full company package.
2. Generate consolidated statements from Balance sheet after branch data is imported for the same financial year.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| "Could not find any applicable branch" | PAN mismatch or no branch companies | Ensure branch companies use the same PAN as HQ and are not marked headquarters |
| Manage Branches icon missing | Row is not headquarters | Only headquarters location type shows the branches action |
| Consolidated BS incomplete | Branch FY data not imported | Import each branch for the same FY before generating |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company exists with imported data
- Stable network connection (large entities may take several minutes)

1. Go to **Company → Manage Companies**.
2. Click **Export Company Data** () on the company row.
3. Wait on the page until the browser download starts.
[Image: Export company data action on Manage Company grid]
"Export duration"
Depending on entity count and data volume, export may take noticeable time. Do not close the client until the file downloads.
1. Save the downloaded archive in a secure location.
2. Use FY-specific export from Financial years when you only need selected years.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Download never starts | Session timeout or server error | Retry; check service connection in Service settings |
| Very slow export | Large multi-year dataset | Expected; wait or export selected FY only |
| Invalid company error | Stale bookmark | Open export from the company grid again |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company selected in the top bar
- Data imported for the FY you want to lock or export

1. Go to **Company → Manage Companies**.
2. Click **Manage FY data** () on the company row.
[Image: Financial years grid with lock and export actions]
1. Review the FY grid (years sync from imported data and master FY list).
2. Click **Lock** on a row to prevent further edits for that company-year.
3. Click **Unlock** to allow edits again.
"Locking a financial year"
Locked FY data cannot be changed in grids until unlocked. Lock only after you have verified imports and adjustments.
1. Select one or more FY rows using the checkboxes.
2. Choose **Export Selected FY** from the grid action bar.
3. Wait for the download to complete.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| FY not listed | No data imported for that year | Import Tally or Excel data for the FY |
| Cannot edit grids | FY is locked | Unlock from this screen if changes are required |
| Export produces empty file | No rows selected | Select at least one FY before export |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Service configuration completed (Configuration → Service)
- User logged into FinAuto Client

1. Click **Company** in the main menu (or open **Company → Manage Companies**).
2. Review the **Manage Company** page header and company selector in the top bar.
1. Click **Add** (or the add icon) in the grid toolbar.
2. Enter company details:
- **Display name** and legal **company name**
- **Income tax number (PAN)** — required for Tally import
- **Depreciation method** (SLM or WDV)
- **CA profile** (optional; create under CA Profiles)
3. Save the record.
"Deleting a company"
Deleting a company removes **all data** (ledgers, stock, etc.) for **all financial years**. Confirm carefully before delete.
Use the **company** and **financial year** dropdowns in the top bar before importing or generating reports.
[Image: Manage Company grid with themed navbar, company bar, and action links for Branches, FY, Export, Balance Sheet]
*Screenshot: FinAuto Client v9.0 — Manage Company grid*

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Duplicate branch after Tally re-import | PAN or branch name changed | Keep PAN consistent; see note on unique branch + PAN on this page |
| PAN missing in Tally import | PAN not set in Tally | Set PAN under Tally **F11 → Features → More Details** |
| Cannot delete company | Active sessions or locked FY | Close other users; unlock FY if needed |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Assets exist in Fixed asset register
- Financial year unlocked if edits are required (Financial years)

1. Go to **Fixed Assets → Asset Shifts**.
2. Review existing shift entries.
[Image: Asset shifts grid with company bar]
1. Click **Add** and select the asset.
2. Enter shift date, from/to location or category, and supporting voucher reference.
3. Save and verify the register reflects the change.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Asset not in list | Not in register | Import asset in Register first |
| Cannot save | FY locked | Unlock FY on company FY screen |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.
- Asset exists in Fixed asset register

1. Go to **Fixed Assets → By Asset**.
2. Search or filter for the asset code or name.
[Image: Depreciation by asset detail view]
1. Inspect capitalization date, purchase and sale values, and year-wise depreciation.
2. Cross-check against Depreciation chart totals for the FY.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Asset not found | Wrong company/FY | Switch company bar selection |
| History incomplete | Asset added mid-year | Verify capitalization date in register |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Fixed asset register imported
- Company depreciation method (SLM or WDV) set at company master

1. Go to **Fixed Assets → Depreciation Chart** (or **FY Depreciation** per menu).
2. Select company and FY in the top bar if not already set.
[Image: Depreciation chart grid with WDV and depreciation columns]
1. Scan asset-wise columns: purchase value, WDV, useful life, depreciation rate, depreciation amount, net block.
2. Export visible columns to Excel when needed for audit working papers.
1. After register edits or method changes, allow recalculation to complete (large registers may take several minutes).

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Zero depreciation | Missing useful life or rate | Edit asset in register |
| Long wait after method change | Large asset count | Wait for client message estimating recalculation time |
| Chart empty | No assets for FY | Import register data |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company created with **depreciation method** (SLM or WDV) set on Manage company
- Audited opening WDV values for first-time import

1. Go to **Fixed Assets → Register**.
2. Review existing asset rows for the selected company.
[Image: Fixed Assets Register grid with company bar and import actions]
1. Scroll to the bottom and download the Excel template.
2. Enter asset-wise data including **opening WDV** per audited accounts.
3. Upload via **Import from Excel**.
[Image: Opening WDV column in Excel template import for fixed assets]
"Opening WDV"
On first import, enter the last written down value (WDV) for each asset exactly as per audited financials. Incorrect opening WDV affects all future depreciation.
- **Tally users:** Import yearly additions via Import from Tally.
- **Excel users:** Add new rows in the same template and re-import.
The register plots automatically in generated financial statements (PPE notes with opening, additions, depreciation, closing WDV).
[Image: PPE register plotted in financial statement notes]

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Import validation errors | Template columns missing | Re-download template from Register page |
| Depreciation method change warning | Existing assets in register | Allow time for recalculation (shown when editing company) |
| PPE notes blank in BS | No register imported | Complete Step 2 import |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company and financial year selected
- Excel templates exported from the relevant modules or sample files from your cloud dashboard

1. Go to **Import → From Excel**.
2. Review **FY data import** and **Company package import** cards.
1. Under **FY data import**, confirm company and FY in the context selector.
2. Choose the Excel file exported from ledgers, stock, or other modules.
3. Submit the form and wait for validation messages.
"Locked financial years"
If a financial year is **locked** for a company, import for that FY is skipped.
Use **Company package import** for zip or Excel exports containing company setup and branch data.
[Image: Import Excel page with FY data import and company package cards]
*Screenshot: FinAuto Client v9.0 — Import → From Excel*

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Import skipped for FY | FY locked | Unlock FY or choose another year |
| Validation errors listed | Template mismatch | Re-export template from the same module version |
| Empty data after import | Wrong company/FY selected | Check top bar selectors |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Source data already in the client for the module you are exporting
- Company and FY selected

1. Open the target module (for example **Trial Balance → Ledgers**).
2. Use the grid **Export** action to download the template workbook.
[Image: Import Data screen with module template upload]
1. Go to **Import → Import Data** (or the **Import Data** entry under Import).
2. Select the module type matching your file.
3. Upload the updated workbook and submit.
"Data overwrite"
Import replaces existing module data for the scope defined in the template. Back up exports before bulk changes.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Column errors | Edited headers removed | Do not change header row names |
| Partial import | Wrong module selected | Match template type to import form |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

1. Select the active **company** and **financial year** in the top bar.
2. Confirm Service is connected.
3. For Tally, set company **PAN** in both Tally and FinAuto.

- Company and FY selected
- Source file matching FinAuto-supported third-party layout (see in-app format hints)

1. Go to **Import → Other Formats**.
2. Read format requirements on the import page.
[Image: Other formats import page with file upload]
1. Select your file.
2. Map or confirm columns as prompted.
3. Submit and review any validation errors.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Unsupported layout | Wrong file type | Use Excel export from supported ERP template |
| Column mismatch | Extra header rows | Remove title rows; keep standard header line |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- A Tally import that reported branch conflicts
- Access to **Import → Resolve Conflicts** (shown when conflicts exist)

1. After import, follow the link or menu to **Resolve Conflicts**.
2. Review the list of conflicting branches.
[Image: Resolve conflicts screen listing branch mapping options]
1. For each conflict, choose the correct FinAuto branch or create a mapping.
2. Save resolutions and re-run import if prompted.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Conflicts repeat | PAN changed between imports | Align PAN on HQ and branches |
| New branch created unexpectedly | Branch renamed in Tally | Map to existing branch manually |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Tally configured with ODBC on port **9000**
- `tcodes.tcp` plugin installed (Installation)
- Correct **company** and **financial year** selected in the client bar
- Tally open with the matching company and period

1. Open Tally and load the company you want to import.
2. Set the period to match the client financial year.
1. Go to **Import → From Tally**.
2. Read the **Instructions** card on the left.
1. In the **Import** card, tick the data types to import (ledgers, stock, fixed assets, aging, etc.).
2. Click **Import from Tally**.
3. Wait until the progress message completes — do not close the page during import.
"Destructive import for ledgers and stock"
For the selected FY, existing **ledger** and **stock** records are **deleted** before import. Fixed assets and aging records update when external IDs match.
[Image: Import from Tally page with Instructions and Import cards, company bar showing FinAuto Demo]
*Screenshot: FinAuto Client v9.0 — Import → From Tally*

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Connection error port 9000 | Tally ODBC off or Tally closed | Enable ODBC; keep Tally running |
| Income tax number not set | PAN missing in Tally | Configure PAN in Tally company features |
| Import hangs | Large data volume | Wait; check Tally company is responsive |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- FinAuto cloud account (register or log in)
- Windows PC with administrator rights to run the `.exe` installer
- TallyPrime (or supported Tally version) if you plan to import from Tally

1. Visit finautoindia.com and register, or log in at finautoindia.com/user/login.
2. Use OTP email login to reach your user dashboard.
1. From the dashboard **Downloads** section, download the latest FinAuto Client `.exe`.
2. Run the installer and finish the setup wizard.
3. Launch **FinAuto Client** from the desktop shortcut.
1. Open **Configuration → Service** in the client.
2. Enter your cloud **domain** and **API key** (generate the key from your FinAuto login dashboard).
3. Click **Update** to sync metadata.
See Service settings for details.
[Image: FinAuto cloud user dashboard with Downloads section and subscription details]
*Screenshot: FinAuto Client v9.0 — cloud dashboard reference for downloads and API key*
1. In Tally, open **Help → F4: Add-Ons**.
2. Add the plugin path from your FinAuto Client install folder, for example:
`C:\Users\\AppData\Local\Programs\Finauto Client\tcodes.tcp`
[Image: Tally Help F4 Add-Ons screen showing FinAuto plugin path]
[Image: Tally TDL configuration confirming tcodes.tcp plugin]
1. In Tally: **Help → Settings → Connectivity → Client/Server Configuration**.
2. Set mode to **Both**.
3. Save and **restart Tally** when prompted.
[Image: Tally ODBC client/server configuration set to Both mode]
Open the client, select or create a company, and confirm the menu bar and company selector appear. Use the  **Help** icon on any screen to open contextual documentation.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Tally connection error on port 9000 | Tally not running or ODBC disabled | Open Tally, enable ODBC on port **9000**, restart Tally |
| Invalid API key message | Expired or rotated key | Generate a new key at finautoindia.com/user/login, update under **Configuration → Service** |
| Plugin not listed in Tally | Wrong path to `tcodes.tcp` | Re-add plugin under **Help → F4: Add-Ons** |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

The top menu in FinAuto Client matches the tabs in this documentation:
| Menu | What you do there |
|------|-------------------|
| **Company** | Create companies, branches, financial years, export data |
| **Import** | Load trial balance, stock, assets, and vouchers from Excel or Tally |
| **Trial Balance** | Edit ledgers and stock after import |
| **Aging** | Trade receivables / payables and Excel aging reports |
| **Fixed Assets** | Register, shifts, depreciation schedules |
| **Share** | Authorised / issued capital, holders, transfers |
| **Reports** | Balance sheet and custom report layouts |
| **Configuration** | Service API key, Tally ODBC, coding rules, updates |

1. Install the client and connect Service.
2. Create a company with PAN and depreciation method.
3. Import from Excel or from Tally.
4. Review Ledgers and run Balance sheet.

- **Cloud mode** (Configuration → Service): faster report generation and remote support when enabled.
- **Local mode**: all data stays on your PC; suitable for air-gapped or offline work.
[Image: FinAuto Client main window]
See Common issues or email support@finautoindia.com. Never send API keys or PAN in email.

- Trial balance imported and ledgers coded
- Service configuration valid (Service settings)
- Company CA profile assigned if required for salutation

1. From **Company** grid links or **Reports → Balance Sheet**, open the balance sheet screen.
2. Select period (annual, quarterly, or half-yearly if enabled).
1. Choose **local** or **cloud** generation if prompted (cloud recommended for large files — see service metadata).
2. Click generate and wait for completion.
3. Download or open the Excel output.
"Unclassified ledgers"
Generation fails if ledgers with balances lack codes. Fix codes in Ledgers or Tally before retrying.
[Image: Balance sheet generation screen with company bar and generate action]
*Screenshot: FinAuto Client v9.0 — Balance sheet generation*

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Unclassified ledger error | Missing codes | Auto-code or assign codes |
| Cloud generation slow | Large dataset | Expected; use cloud mode for support visibility |
| Rounding / denomination | Excel MASTER SHEET | Use **Convert To** dropdown in exported MASTER SHEET (see FAQ) |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company selected in the top bar
- Report format chosen on Manage company

1. Go to **Reports → Customize** (or **Accounting Policies** per legacy menu).
2. Review existing customization rows for the company.
[Image: Customize reports grid with accounting policy entries]
1. Click **Add** or edit an existing note.
2. Enter section key, display text, and ordering as required by your balance sheet format.
3. Save changes before generating Balance sheet.
1. Generate balance sheet for the FY.
2. Confirm custom notes appear in the exported report package.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Note not in BS | Wrong company or format | Verify company bar and report format |
| Duplicate sections | Overlapping keys | Remove or merge duplicate customization rows |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company selected in the top bar
- Share capital structure known from MCA filings

1. Go to **Share → Authorized**.
2. Review existing authorized classes.
[Image: Authorized capital grid with share classes]
1. Click **Add** to create a share class with face value and authorized count.
2. Edit rows to correct face value or authorized shares before subscribed/issued entries.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Cannot issue more than authorized | Authorized count too low | Increase authorized shares first |
| Duplicate share type | Class already exists | Edit existing row instead of adding |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Issued capital and Shareholders up to date
- Buyback board resolution date and price

1. Go to **Share → Buyback**.
2. Click **Add** and enter buyback date, shares cancelled, and amount.
[Image: Share buyback entry grid]
"Double entry required"
After buyback, withdraw proportionate capital from individual shareholders in Transfer logs on the **same date** as the buyback. Both entries are required for correct holdings.
1. Open Transfer logs.
2. Record seller-side reductions matching the buyback allocation.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Holding report imbalanced | Missing transfer log | Add matching transfer on buyback date |
| Cannot buy back | Insufficient issued shares | Verify issued capital counts |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Company selected
- Shareholder list from statutory registers or import template

1. Go to **Share → Shareholders**.
2. Review shareholder IDs, names, and categories.
[Image: Shareholders grid with holder categories]
1. Click **Add** for new shareholders or edit existing rows.
2. Set **holder type** (category) for each shareholder — required for correct disclosure in Holding report.
1. Download the share capital Excel template from Subscribed capital.
2. Import holders and capital data, then return here to verify categories.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Holder missing after import | Template row skipped | Re-import with valid shareholder ID |
| Wrong disclosure bucket | Category not set | Edit holder type on this grid |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Authorized, Issued, Subscribed, and Transfer logs up to date
- Company and FY selected in the top bar

1. Go to **Share → Holding Report** (Share Holding View).
2. Review shareholder, share type, face value, percentage, capital, and share count columns.
[Image: Share holding report grid with cumulative percentages]
The grid shows cumulative holdings with **Last Updated** action date per holder.
1. Use the grid **Excel** export for audit working papers or MCA schedules.
2. For holder-wise FY drill-down, use the **Holder FY** view from the Share menu (same documentation applies).
1. Compare totals to Subscribed capital.
2. Fix gaps via Transfer logs before finalizing Balance sheet.
The **Holder FY** screen (`share` / `holder_fy`) shows year-specific holder movements; maintain data using the same share menus above.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Empty grid | No share data for FY | Import subscribed capital |
| Percentages ≠ 100% | Missing transfers | Post transfers through FY end |
| Stale Last Updated | No recent transfer | Add transfer log with correct date |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Authorized capital configured
- Allotment dates and counts from board resolutions

1. Go to **Share → Issued**.
2. Review issued classes and counts.
[Image: Issued capital grid]
1. Click **Add** and link to authorized class.
2. Enter issue date, number of shares, and consideration details.
3. Update Subscribed capital and Payments as needed.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Validation on share count | Exceeds authorized | Increase authorized capital |
| Holding % wrong | Missing transfer log | Post transfers in Transfer logs |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.
- Subscribed capital entries exist

1. Go to **Share → Payments**.
2. Review payment dates and amounts per shareholder.
[Image: Share capital payments grid]
1. Click **Add** and link to shareholder and share class.
2. Enter receipt date, amount, and reference (bank/cheque).
3. Reconcile paid-up capital in Holding report.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Over-payment warning | Exceeds subscribed | Adjust subscribed amount or payment |
| Holding capital wrong | Payments not entered | Add payment rows for the FY |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Authorized capital defined
- Shareholders list (can be created via import)

1. Go to **Share → Subscribed**.
2. Review subscribed amounts per shareholder and class.
[Image: Subscribed capital grid with Excel template link]
1. Scroll to the bottom and click **Download Excel Template**.
2. Fill share details (holder, class, shares, amounts).
3. Go to **Import → Import from Excel** under Share and upload the file.
1. Update Shareholder categories after import.
2. Open Holding report to confirm percentages.

| Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution |
|---------|--------------|------------|
| Import rejected | Invalid holder ID | Create shareholders first or use template IDs |
| Totals do not tie | Rounding in template | Use template formulas; re-export |
See also Common issues.
**Need more help?** Contact support@finautoindia.com. Do not share API keys or PAN in email.

- Shareholders and Issued capital configured
- Transfer deed dates and parties

1. Go to **Share → Transfer Logs**.
2. Review historical transfers for the company.
[Image: Share transfer logs grid]
